formatNotes: 40 men and 40 women qualified through eight Regionals (top five per region). 14 scored events over five days; Wednesday August 1 packed four events (including a surprise marathon row) and Thursday August 2 was an individual rest day. No mid-competition cuts; the only field reduction was Sara Sigmundsdottir's injury withdrawal before Event 10. Standard Games points table, 100 points per event win. The Clean and Jerk Speed Ladder used three elimination rounds (top 20, then top 5 advancing) and was scored by placement. The order of the two Saturday-night Bicouplets was decided by fan vote.
yearSummary: The second Madison Games opened with what Dave Castro billed as the hardest single day in Games history: a criterium bike race, 30 ring muscle-ups, the CrossFit Total and a surprise full-marathon row, all on Wednesday. Programming leaned hard into the 'unknown and unknowable': Chaos was kept secret until athletes were on the floor, the Battleground sent vested athletes through an obstacle course with Rescue Randy drags, and fans voted on the order of the Saturday-night Bicouplets. The tumbler pull and Rescue Randy mannequin debuted, and the CrossFit Total returned to the Games for the first time since 2007. Mat Fraser won his third consecutive title with a record 220-point margin over Patrick Vellner, while Tia-Clair Toomey defended her title by 64 points over rookie runner-up (and Rookie of the Year) Laura Horvath.

events.name: Crit
events.description:
Criterium-style road bike race.
10 laps of a ~1,200-m loop course around the Alliant Energy Center grounds (~12 km total).
Rolling start; white flag signals the final lap.
Time cap: 30 minutes.
events.notes: First criterium-format bike race at the Games (bikes had previously appeared in the 2017 Cyclocross). Patrick Vellner crashed and finished 35th, an early hole in his title campaign.

events.name: 30 Muscle-Ups
events.description:
For time:
30 ring muscle-ups.
One set of rings per athlete.
Time cap: 5 minutes.
events.notes: Pure gymnastics sprint contested in the Coliseum on the opening day.

events.name: CrossFit Total
events.description:
Max total load:
1-rep-max back squat
1-rep-max shoulder press
1-rep-max deadlift
Up to 3 attempts per lift within a 4-minute window per lift (12 minutes total).
Score is the sum of the heaviest successful attempt at each lift.
events.notes: First appearance of the CrossFit Total benchmark at the Games since 2007. Sara Sigmundsdottir fractured a rib during the competition and ultimately withdrew before Event 10. Source conflict: the official workout page describes 3 attempts per lift in 4-minute windows, while Wikipedia describes one attempt per 4-minute lift window; official source preferred.

events.name: Marathon Row
events.description:
For time:
Row 42,195 meters (a full marathon) on the Concept2 rower.
Time cap: 4 hours.
events.notes: Surprise event revealed to athletes at the welcome dinner; it capped a four-event opening day billed by Dave Castro as the hardest in Games history and remains the longest single event (by duration) ever contested at the Games. Margaux Alvarez's winning time beat nine of the men. Mat Fraser finished 11th (2:48:36) and hobbled off his rower.

events.name: The Battleground
events.description:
For time, wearing a weighted vest (men 20 lb, women 14 lb):
Rescue Randy drag (weighted rescue mannequin)
2 rope climbs (20-ft ropes of different diameters)
Obstacle-course run (cargo net, wall climbs, monkey bars, rope swings, log balances)
2 rope climbs
Rescue Randy drag back to the finish.
Time cap: 11 minutes (men), 12 minutes (women).
events.notes: Contested on a purpose-built outdoor obstacle course. Time cap differed by division (11 min men, 12 min women, per games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2018); a single numeric timeCapMin cannot represent both divisions, so it is null. Both Mat Fraser and Patrick Vellner fell from the cargo-net obstacle; Vellner bruised his lungs but kept competing.

events.name: Clean and Jerk Speed Ladder
events.description:
Three-stage elimination speed ladder: one clean and jerk at each of 5 ascending barbells per round, racing for finish order.
Quarterfinal (all 40 athletes, 1-minute cap): men 245-255-265-270-275 lb, women 155-160-165-170-175 lb. Top 20 advance.
Semifinal (2-minute cap): men 280-290-300-305-310 lb, women 180-185-190-195-200 lb. Top 5 advance.
Final (3-minute cap): men 315-325-335-340-345 lb, women 205-210-215-220-225 lb.
Scored by overall placement across the rounds.
events.notes: Elimination bracket scored by placement rather than time or load (official leaderboard displays the winner's score as '1 pt'). Round time caps were 1, 2 and 3 minutes; there was no single event-wide cap, so timeCapMin is null.

events.name: Fibonacci
events.description:
For time:
5 parallette handstand push-ups, 5 double-kettlebell deadlifts
8 parallette handstand push-ups, 8 double-kettlebell deadlifts
13 parallette handstand push-ups, 13 double-kettlebell deadlifts
Then 89-ft double-kettlebell overhead walking lunge.
Parallette deficit: men 14 in., women 8 in.
Kettlebell deadlifts: men 2x203-lb KBs, women 2x124-lb KBs.
Overhead lunge: men 2x53-lb KBs, women 2x35-lb KBs.
Rep scheme and distance follow the Fibonacci sequence (5, 8, 13 ... 89).
Time cap: 6 minutes.
events.notes: Updated, modified version of the 2017 Fibonacci Final. Per Wikipedia only four men finished within the cap, while 23 women finished the updated version.

events.name: Madison Triplus
events.description:
For time:
Swim 500 meters in Lake Monona
Paddle 1,000 meters on a stand-up paddleboard
Run 2,000 meters, finishing back at the Alliant Energy Center.
Time cap: 40 minutes.
events.notes: Tia-Clair Toomey's 25:35.01 was faster than the men's winning time. Games rookie Dean Linder-Leighton took his first career event win after pulling ahead on the paddle. Paddleboards had previously appeared at the Games (2015 Pier Paddle).

events.name: Chaos
events.description:
For time, workout unknown to athletes until they were on the competition floor:
35-cal. SkiErg (women 30)
30 burpees to bar (women 25)
45 single-arm dumbbell overhead squats, 50-lb DB (women 40 reps, 35-lb DB)
40 single-leg squats (women 45)
25 box jump-overs, 42-in. box (women 36-in.)
110-ft tumbler pull, 400 lb (women 300 lb).
Time cap: 12 minutes.
events.notes: Athletes were sequestered and discovered the workout only when they hit the floor, a nod to CrossFit's 'unknown and unknowable' ethos. The 400/300-lb tumbler (a rolling drum pulled hand-over-hand) made its Games debut. Per the official workout page, rep counts crossed over between divisions: men did 45 DB overhead squats and 40 single-leg squats, women 40 and 45 (confirmed on both the official page and Wikipedia).

events.name: Bicouplet 2
events.description:
For time:
12-9-6 reps of:
Snatches (men 135 lb, women 85 lb)
Bar muscle-ups.
Time cap: 6 minutes.
events.notes: Fans voted on which Bicouplet would be contested first; Bicouplet 2 ran first as Event 10, with only a short rest before Bicouplet 1. Sara Sigmundsdottir (rib fracture) withdrew from the competition before this event. 2014 champion Camille Leblanc-Bazinet took the women's win.

events.name: Bicouplet 1
events.description:
For time:
21-15-9 reps of:
Snatches (men 85 lb, women 55 lb)
Chest-to-bar pull-ups.
Time cap: 6 minutes.
events.notes: Contested immediately after Bicouplet 2 following a short rest; the back-to-back order was decided by fan vote, with the lighter 21-15-9 couplet ending the Saturday night session.

events.name: Two-Stroke Pull
events.description:
5 rounds for time:
300-meter run
Assault Bike calories (men 20, women 15)
44-ft hand-over-hand sled pull (men 183 lb, women 153 lb).
Time cap: 18 minutes.
events.notes: Lukas Högberg's event win helped vault him onto the overall podium (3rd). Laura Horváth's second event win of the weekend kept her in the title hunt with Toomey.

events.name: Handstand Walk
events.description:
For time:
50 double-unders with a heavy jump rope
Then a handstand-walk obstacle course:
slalom through pylons, up and over a ramp, up and down stairs, and a walk across parallel bars.
Each obstacle had to be completed without coming down from the hands; athletes restarted an obstacle if they broke.
Time cap: 4 minutes.
events.notes: First handstand-walk obstacle course at the Games (the handstand walk itself was not new). Renowned handbalancer Cody Anderson dominated the men's field.

events.name: Aeneas
events.description:
For time:
Pegboard ascents (men 5, women 4)
40 thrusters (men 85 lb, women 55 lb)
Then three 33-ft yoke carries at progressively heavier loads:
men 425 lb, then 565 lb, then 665 lb; women 345 lb, then 405 lb, then 445 lb
(the yoke is loaded heavier between carries, finishing across the line with the heaviest yoke).
Time cap: 8 minutes.
events.notes: Named for Aeneas, who carried his father out of burning Troy (echoed in the yoke carry). Fraser had already mathematically clinched his third straight title and still won the event, finishing 220 points clear of Vellner, then the largest margin in Games history. Horváth's event win sealed second overall and Rookie of the Year; Toomey took her second straight title by 64 points.
